before: A checkpoint of version 6 opened with a suggestion, a comment or an earlier attribution whose Word name was not its person's, so a card could show one name for another person. The version 5 reader refused such a file.
after: The version 6 reader refuses such a file as checkpoint-manifest, with the same rule as the version 5 reader.
reason: A room writes each person's Word name from the person, so every checkpoint a room writes still opens. Only a changed file is refused. Change messages, the change log and the Yjs document format do not change.
